### MyFitnessPal {#review-app-3}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 6, 2026 - Sep 12, 2026

         **Review examples:**
            1. _MyFitnessFail ❌_, Sep 12, 2026, 1/5: "Will not renew Premium.I would leave zero stars if I could. After the update, I actually thought I had forgotten to renew my Premium subscription because the interface was so unrecognizable.It is a massive bummer because I used to be able to see everything clearly on one page. Now, everything is buried. I spent 10 minutes hunting for old features and refuse to waste any more time. It feels like developers just move things around for the sake of it, thinking it’s "better" when it actually makes the app frustrating to use.I will absolutely NOT be renewing my Premium subscription when it comes due. Please bring back the old version."
            2. _Twig n Berries_, Sep 8, 2026, 1/5: "I signed up for the premium account. Each time I try to use the barcode scanner, it tells me I need to upgrade to premium. When I click on “okay” it tells me I’m already subscribed…. Endless loop. Complete ripoff."
            3. _cameronstarrenergy_, Sep 8, 2026, 1/5: "I have been a paid user for years but recently the app shows that I am not a paid user with ads popping up. When I go to upgrade it says I am already a subscriber. I have had to delete the app and restart it in order for it to work again but it doesn’t last. Please fix this."
<!--/ir-theme-->

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      7 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 19, 2026 - Sep 13, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _RedouanNhil_, Sep 12, 2026, 1/5: "I have been a paying Premium subscriber for well over a year, and the biggest draw was always the simplicity of the old daily dashboard—specifically the clean donut charts / progress rings that gave an instant visual breakdown of my remaining calories and macros. On top of that, having fixed macro targets that didn't automatically change with logged workout calories gave me total control over how much of my burned calories to eat back or save. this new interface overhaul is horrible. They truly fixed something that wasn't broken. Whoever decided on this change clearly doesn't use the app on a daily basis. Counting calories is already a pain, but the old design made it effortless. This update adds unnecessary friction, making tracking a chore to the point where I am losing motivation to use the app—making it much harder to reach my fitness goals. Please bring back the old design or provide an option for a legacy view. This was a huge step backward for loyal, paying users."
            2. _SayeedSaeedi_, Sep 12, 2026, 1/5: "Ironically this app’s aim is to keep you consistent but it’s so buggy and inconsistent you would rather keep track in your notes app. Just renewed the premium (darn auto renew) and suddenly the app cant tell who purchased it and disabled the premium features. Don’t worry it kept the cache of items you input via the premium features. Support is useless and invokes no hope that they can fix things quickly."
            3. _LoriLins64_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "Note: I am a paid user, and have been using MFP for a couple of years now, quite happily. But this new update is absolutely horrific, the worst I’ve ever seen. They took a very user-friendly app and made it ridiculously unusable. What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."
<!--/ir-theme-->

            1. _mo4958589594_, Jan 24, 2026, 2/5: "The app has so much potential but is so broken. It alerts me on the wrong days, it does a ludicrous amount of reps and weight for where I’m at in my fitness ability, it will give me 6 exercises for my biceps in one day when my split is meant to be full body every work out. It COULD be great, but it’s not there. I won’t be renewing my subscription"

Pretty frustrating having to figure out the plate issues or bar weight for smith machine vs Olympic in the middle of the workouts while also dealing with it recommending weights that can not be reached with the gear you have. It happens frequently enough that I’m considering looking for an alternative. But this is a good app for generating workouts on a macro level"
            3. _kllre2847_, Sep 13, 2026, 4/5: "I really love this app. I feel there is enough variety and challenge that I don’t get bored and I love that it is very customizable and geared toward my personal goals. My only complaint is that I wish there was a dedicated core workout or that core was more of a focus for the workouts. Pretty much all I get are deadbugs and planks but I don’t always want to go searching to add other exercises, so typically I turn to YouTube to do an actual guided core workout after my Fitbod workout. Adding more core-focused sets would make this app pretty much perfect!"
